title: Deep Q-Network
description: Value-based reinforcement learning model combining Q-learning with deep neural network function estimators.
name: Deep Q-Network
summary: Deep Q-Networks (DQN) estimate action-value (Q) functions using deep convolutional or linear networks, utilizing experience replay buffers and target network updates to stabilize training.
use_when: Training autonomous agents in discrete, low-dimensional action spaces with simulation environments.
avoid_when: Action spaces are continuous or training stability and sample efficiency are prioritized.
pros: Learns to solve complex control policies directly from raw pixel/feature inputs.
Experience replay buffer stabilizes convergence by decorrelating samples.
Off-policy design supports learning from historical demonstration logs.
cons: Prone to Q-value overestimation biases (mitigated by Double DQN).
Highly sample inefficient, requiring millions of interactions to converge.
Does not natively support continuous action spaces.

key_hyperparams.name: gamma
key_hyperparams.note: Discount factor for future rewards. Determines the agent's horizon of planning.
